summary: Shows using win_domain_user and win_domain_group to manage Active Directory users and groups, with a looped example creating several domain accounts.
questions: How do I create Active Directory users in bulk with Ansible?
Which module manages domain groups on Windows?
How do I set a password only when a domain user is first created?

answer_card.title: Creating domain users in bulk
answer_card.answer_md:
Use `win_domain_user` (and `win_domain_group` for groups):

```yaml
- win_domain_user:
    name: '{{ item.name }}'
    upn: '{{ item.name }}@MY.DOMAIN.COM'
    password: '{{ item.password }}'
    groups: [Test User, Application]
    company: Ansible
    update_password: on_create
  loop:
  - {name: Test User, password: ...}
```

`update_password: on_create` only sets the password when the account is created.
